rows.name: Birth to early care
rows.why: Birth records are universal but nothing carries them forward except CalKIDS. ECE programs assign local IDs.

rows.name: Health and home visiting to early care
rows.why: Medi-Cal, WIC and home visiting use CIN or program IDs. HIPAA and W&I Code 10850 limit sharing with ECE without a framework.

rows.name: Across ECE programs (CDE, CDSS, Head Start, First 5)
rows.why: Child-level data exists in CDE and CDSS systems but cannot be unduplicated. Head Start and First 5 data stay local.

rows.name: Early care to TK and kindergarten
rows.why: SSID is optional in CAPSDAC and absent elsewhere. Kindergarten records carry no preschool history.

rows.name: Human services to TK-12
rows.why: Direct certification and the foster match work routinely, but only as flags. The CIN link is not retained.

rows.name: TK-12 to postsecondary
rows.why: Strongest handoff. SSID reaches CCCApply and CaliforniaColleges.edu. CCI still lacks C2C outcomes; course data definitions vary.

rows.name: Community college to CSU and UC
rows.why: All three are in C2C. Definitions differ across segments and the transfer dashboard is still being built.

rows.name: Private, out-of-state and adult education
rows.why: BPPE schools report aggregates, AICCU is voluntary, adult schools are outside C2C, NSC is unused.

rows.name: Postsecondary to UI-covered jobs
rows.why: EDD wages are in C2C, but students without SSNs fall out and there is no occupation or hours field.

rows.name: Apprenticeship and job training to earnings
rows.why: DAS, CalJOBS and ETP joined in 2025 and are still being imported. Program taxonomies differ.

rows.name: Self-employed, gig, federal and out-of-state work
rows.why: Outside UI wage records entirely. FTB and SWIS hold the data but are not available for C2C.

rows.name: Educator pipeline (ECE and TK-12)
rows.why: TK-12 teachers link through SEID and CTC. ECE educators have permits but no employment records.

rows.name: Justice, homelessness and reentry
rows.why: CDCR, HMIS/HDIS and juvenile justice data do not reach education or wage records.
